subject: maths
question: Three men or five women can do a work in 57 days. In how many days can nine men and four women do that same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Three men or five women can do a work in 57 days

**Formula used:**

(M1 × D1)/W1 = (M2 × D2)/W2

**Calculation:**

3 Men = 5 women

1 man = (5/3) women

9 Men = 9 × (5/3) women = 15 women

Total work = 5 × 57 = 285 units

9 men and 4 women = 15 women + 4 women = 19 women

Time taken = 285 ÷ 19 = 15 days

**∴ The nine men and four women will do the same work in 15 days.**
